- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several art books categorized into different sections: Art History and Theory, Artist Monographs and Biographies, Art Movements and Styles, Contemporary Art and Trends, and Artistic Techniques and Practices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended books include:

  - "Vincent and Theo: The Van Gogh Brothers" by Deborah Heiligman
  - "Chuck Close: Life" by Christopher Finch
  - "Cubism: A History and an Analysis, 1907-1914" by John Golding
  - "Abstract Expressionism" by David Anfam
  - "Surrealism: The Dream Startup" by Mary Ann Caws
  - "Art in the Age of Anxiety" by Mark Fisher
  - "The Artist's Museum" by Corinne Diserens
  - "New Museum's HERE AND ELSEWHERE" edited by Massimiliano Gioni
  - "The New Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain" by Betty Edwards
  - "The Art of Color" by Johannes Itten
  - "The Natural Way to Paint" by Frank Webb
- [PREFERENCE] User is particularly interested in abstract expressionist pieces.
